article.headline: Rested Cavaliers Storm Chicago Facing Exhausted Bulls After 151-145 Overtime Heartbreak
article.summary: The Cleveland Cavaliers face the struggling Chicago Bulls on Monday, Nov. 23, at the United Center following Chicago's grueling overtime loss.
article.body:
The Chicago Bulls enter Monday's matchup at the United Center under immense physical strain after playing an overtime game against the Denver Nuggets just last night. Every starter for Chicago logged over 40 minutes in that 151-145 loss, leaving them with less than 24 hours of recovery time before tipping off against a Cleveland Cavaliers squad that enjoyed an entire weekend off. This disparity in rest is a significant focal point as Cleveland looks to capitalize on their opponent's potential fatigue and slower pace.

For the Cavaliers, exploiting the Bulls' defensive vulnerabilities is essential to maintaining momentum. Chicago currently ranks among the league's worst defensively, allowing an average of 124.6 points per game. While Cleveland holds a high-scoring offense, their path to victory relies on tightening their own defensive execution. The Cavs have historically struggled to defend the perimeter, but they face a Chicago team that sits 28th in three-point shooting percentage, hitting less than 33% of their attempts.

Cleveland enters the contest with confidence, having secured a 128-119 victory over the Indiana Pacers in their previous outing. James Harden spearheaded that win with 51 points, complemented by Donovan Mitchell and Peyton Watson. In contrast, the Bulls arrive following two consecutive losses, despite a historic triple-double performance from Josh Giddey, who recorded 23 points, 22 assists, and 14 rebounds against Denver. Cleveland has historically dominated this rivalry, winning seven of the previous ten meetings between the two franchises. The Cavaliers are currently seeking to extend their recent success against a Chicago lineup featuring Giddey, Buddy Hield, and Matas Buzelis.

article.headline: الأهلي يعلن رحيل الحسين عموتة رسمياً عقب الخسارة أمام بيراميدز بثنائية
article.summary: أعلن النادي الأهلي رحيل مديره الفني الحسين عموتة عن منصبه بعد الهزيمة بهدفين دون رد في الدوري المصري.
article.body:
أعلن النادي الأهلي بشكل رسمي رحيل المدير الفني الحسين عموتة عن قيادة الفريق الأول لكرة القدم، وذلك في أعقاب الخسارة التي تعرض لها الفريق أمام بيراميدز بهدفين دون رد، في المباراة التي أقيمت على استاد القاهرة الدولي ضمن منافسات الجولة التاسعة من الدوري المصري الممتاز. وجاء هذا القرار بعد حالة من الغضب الجماهيري وتراجع النتائج في المواجهة الأخيرة.

ويأتي هذا الرحيل ليضع حداً لمسيرة عموتة مع الفريق، حيث كان مجلس إدارة النادي الأهلي برئاسة محمود الخطيب قد عقد اجتماعاً طارئاً ضم كلاً من نائب رئيس النادي ياسين منصور وعضو المجلس سيد عبد الحفيظ؛ لبحث مصير المدير الفني وتفاصيل الشرط الجزائي الذي يقدر بحوالي 435 ألف دولار، وهي قيمة راتب 3 أشهر له ولجهازه المعاون بالكامل.

وكان الحسين عموتة قد أعرب في وقت سابق عقب المباراة عن إحباطه الشديد من النتيجة، معتذراً لجماهير الأهلي عن الأداء الذي ظهر به اللاعبون، ومؤكداً أن المسؤولية مشتركة ولا تقع على عاتق المدير الفني وحده. وأوضح عموتة أن الفريق لم يظهر بالمستوى المنتظر رغم التحضيرات الجيدة، مشيراً إلى أن أغلب العناصر لم تكن في حالتها الفنية والذهنية المطلوبة لمواجهة بيراميدز.

ومع تأكيد النادي الأهلي رسمياً لرحيل المدير الفني، تتجه أنظار الإدارة الآن نحو الفترة المقبلة، حيث كشفت المصادر عن استقرار المجلس على وضع مجموعة من الأسماء المرشحة لخلافة عموتة في منصبه خلال الأيام القليلة القادمة، وذلك في محاولة لترتيب أوراق الفريق في منافسات الدوري المصري.

news.title: Al-Ittihad to Host Uzbekistan's Pakhtakor in AFC Champions League Elite Tomorrow
news.og_title: Al-Ittihad to Host Uzbekistan's Pakhtakor in AFC Champions League Elite Tomorrow
news.og_desc:
Jeddah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Saudi Arabia's Al-Ittihad will host Uzbekistan's Pakhtakor tomorrow at King Abdullah Sports City Stadium in Jeddah in the fifth round of the West Region league stage of the 2026–2027 AFC Champions League Elite.
    Al-Ittihad will seek to return to winning ways and strengthen its chances of advancing to the next round, drawing confidence from its favorable record against Pakhtakor. The two sides have met four times, with Al-Ittihad remaining unbeaten and winning three of those encounters. The Jeddah-based side will also look to secure its first home win in this season's competition after losing both previous home matches.
    The match comes at a crucial stage for Al-Ittihad, which needs all three points after suffering a 4–1 defeat to the UAE's Al-Ain. With four points, the team currently sits 10th in the standings and needs positive results in its remaining matches to improve its chances of reaching the round of 16.
    Pakhtakor, meanwhile, has two points and will be looking to improve its position. However, the Uzbek side faces a difficult away challenge, having failed to win any of its last six away matches in the AFC Champions League Elite, recording three draws and three defeats.
    Al-Ain currently leads the West Region standings with 12 points, followed by Al-Hilal, Esteghlal, and Shabab Al-Ahli, each with nine points. Al-Qadsiah and Saudi Arabia's Al-Ahli have eight points apiece, while Al-Nassr has six points from three matches.
    Al-Shamal follows with five points, while Neftchi and Al-Ittihad have four points each. Al-Wasl and Air Force SC have three points apiece, followed by Tractor, Pakhtakor, and Al-Sadd with two points each. Al-Gharafa remains without a point.
    -- SPA
21:03 Local Time 18:03 GMT
